changes: Replace stubs with independent one-time hooks, preventing shared-counter repeat notifications.
Restore original methods before calling user code; preserve return values, arguments and receivers.
Preserve explicit redecoration while preventing retained hooks or callbacks from repeating a notification or clobbering replacement methods.
Support readable-only and writable-only streams; validate both directions before mutation.
Supply self-contained structural types, including constructor-style .call(this) use.
